Name: no$gba Integration
Description: Download, update and save management for the no$gba emulator (Game Boy Advance, Nintendo DS, DSiWare). Writes its saves in the raw format every other emulator reads.
Credits: Many thanks to Martin Korth for no$gba and for GBATEK, and to the melonDS team, whose DSi NAND code this plugin uses to prepare a console - which is why it is GPL-3.0.
